labels.label: That afternoon: Holmes and Watson are to leave, so that Dr. Roylott will not return and see them
That afternoon: Holmes and Watson leave Miss Stoner

note: Intended at ¶194; by ¶195 they have gone to the inn. Not ordered against any earlier point of Dr. Roylott's journey home; ¶195 shows them at the inn before he drives past.

label: That day: Holmes and Watson engage a bedroom and sitting-room at the Crown Inn
quote: no difficulty in engaging a bedroom and sitting-room at the Crown Inn

label: At dusk: Dr. Roylott drives past, beside the lad who drives him
quote: At dusk we saw Dr. Grimesby Roylott drive past

label: At dusk: the lad struggles with the iron gates, and Dr. Roylott roars and shakes his fists at him
quote: some slight difficulty in undoing the heavy iron gates

label: At dusk: the trap drives on through the gates
quote: The trap drove on

labels.label: This evening at the earliest: Dr. Roylott is expected back
At dusk: Dr. Roylott comes back to Stoke Moran

note: Expected at ¶126; ¶195 shows him driven in at the gates at dusk.

label: At dusk, a few minutes later: a lamp is lit in one of the sitting-rooms, and a light springs up among the trees
quote: a few minutes later we saw a sudden light spring up among the trees

label: That evening, in the gathering darkness: Holmes has scruples about taking Watson to-night
quote: I have really some scruples as to taking you to-night

label: That evening: Watson asks whether he can be of assistance
quote: Can I be of assistance?

label: That evening: Holmes says Watson's presence might be invaluable
quote: Your presence might be invaluable.

label: That evening: Watson says he will certainly come
quote: Then I shall certainly come.

label: That evening: Holmes thanks Watson
quote: It is very kind of you.

label: That evening: Watson says Holmes must have seen more in the rooms than he did
quote: You have evidently seen more in these rooms than was visible to me.

label: That evening: Holmes says he saw no more, but may have deduced a little more
quote: I fancy that I may have deduced a little more

label: That evening: Watson says he saw nothing remarkable save the bell-rope
quote: I saw nothing remarkable save the bell-rope

label: That evening: Holmes asks whether Watson saw the ventilator
quote: You saw the ventilator, too?

label: That evening: Watson says the opening was too small to matter
quote: It was so small that a rat could hardly pass through.

labels.label: Before they came to Stoke Moran: Holmes knows that they will find a ventilator
Before they came to Stoke Moran: Holmes deduces a ventilator from Miss Stoner's statement

label: Before they came to Stoke Moran: Holmes knows that they will find a ventilator
quote: I knew that we should find a ventilator before ever we came to Stoke Moran
note: ¶208: the deduction comes from her statement that her sister could smell the cigar.

label: That evening: Holmes says he knew they would find a ventilator
quote: I knew that we should find a ventilator

label: That evening: Watson exclaims in surprise
quote: My dear Holmes!

label: That evening: Holmes explains how the smell of the cigar told him of a ventilator
quote: I deduced a ventilator.

label: That evening: Watson asks what harm there can be in a ventilator
quote: But what harm can there be in that?

label: That evening: Holmes points to a curious coincidence of dates
quote: a curious coincidence of dates

note: ¶155–156: about the same time as the bell-rope, and not ordered against it. ¶210: Holmes puts the making of it before the lady's death.

label: That evening: Watson says he cannot yet see any connection
quote: I cannot as yet see any connection.

label: That evening: Holmes asks whether Watson saw anything peculiar about the bed
quote: Did you observe anything very peculiar about that bed?

label: That evening: Watson answers that he did not
quote: No.

label: That evening: Holmes says the bed was clamped to the floor
quote: It was clamped to the floor.

label: That evening: Watson says he has never seen a bed fastened like that
quote: I cannot say that I have.

label: That evening: Holmes says the bed must always stay in the same position to the ventilator and the rope
quote: It must always be in the same relative position to the ventilator and to the rope

label: That evening: Watson cries out that he dimly sees what Holmes is hinting at
quote: I seem to see dimly what you are hinting at

label: Soon: a subtle and horrible crime, Watson fears, unless it is prevented
quote: We are only just in time to prevent some subtle and horrible crime
note: What Watson fears; it has not happened by the end of this scene.

label: In the past: Palmer and Pritchard are among the heads of their profession
quote: Palmer and Pritchard were among the heads of their profession

label: That evening: Holmes speaks of doctors who go wrong, and proposes a quiet pipe
quote: When a doctor does go wrong he is the first of criminals

label: Before the night is over: Holmes expects horrors enough
quote: we shall have horrors enough before the night is over
note: What Holmes expects; it has not happened by the end of this scene.

label: For a few hours: Holmes means them to have a quiet pipe and think of something more cheerful
quote: let us have a quiet pipe
note: Proposed; the text does not say more of it.

label: About nine o'clock: the light among the trees is put out, and all is dark towards the Manor House
quote: About nine o’clock the light among the trees was extinguished

label: From about nine: two hours pass slowly
quote: Two hours passed slowly away

labels.label: To-night: Miss Stoner is to put her lamp in the window as a signal
The stroke of eleven: a single bright light shines out in front of them
The stroke of eleven: the signal shines out from the middle window

note: Told as an instruction at ¶184; ¶219–220 show the light at eleven, which Holmes takes for the signal.

label: The stroke of eleven: Holmes springs to his feet and says it is their signal, from the middle window
quote: That is our signal

label: That night: as they pass out, Holmes tells the landlord they are going on a late visit
quote: he exchanged a few words with the landlord

label: That night, a moment later: Holmes and Watson are out on the dark road, with one yellow light in front of them
quote: A moment later we were out on the dark road
